entities.name: Adam Pavlásek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Adam Pavlásek is a Czech professional tennis player who specializes in doubles. He reached his career-high ATP doubles ranking of world No. 29 on 4 November 2024 and a singles ranking of world No. 72 in January 2017. He is the current No. 3 Czech ATP doubles player.
